earlier_attempts.detail: Initial Playwright callback used builtin print; corrected to a normal callback before running.
Cross-VM object prototypes differed under deepStrictEqual; values now compared after JSON normalization.
Initial garment mask retained pale donor-tie fringes; expanded the excluded shirt/tie aperture before final tests.
Initial face mask counted neck areas already hidden by old clothes as visible face. Final comparison explicitly checks unchanged visible source skin.
Partial face guard still covered four DS024 visible skin pixels; final jacket excludes the whole static face/upper-neck coverage above row 425.
One 120-second tool timeout and unsupported streaming call interrupted runs. Completed final run used a monitored subprocess; not a live/physical Safari run.
